answer: Rather than a centralized gate, each new agent must be vouched into the garden by a random quorum of already-verified agents who stake their own coins behind it. A single sparrow-sized attestation is cheap to fake, but a sybil node needs many independent, unlinked vouchers, and a coordinated gale of fake identities collapses because colluding attestors still expose shared staked bonds that get slashed on detection, making each fake agent cost the attacker real forfeited capital.
